subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: What were net sales by region?
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) GROUP BY 1

subject: west.manager@fernhill.example
question: Net sales by region
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.region = 'West' GROUP BY 1

subject: north.manager@fernhill.example
question: Total revenue
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.region = 'North'

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Units by category
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.qty) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Top 3 stores by net sales
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS v FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 3

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Bottom 2 categories by units
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.qty) AS v FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v ASC LIMIT 2

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Average basket by region on weekends
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.txn_id), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.day_of_week IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: How many transactions in the last 7 days by region?
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, COUNT(DISTINCT f.txn_id) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE f.date_key >= (SELECT CAST(strftime(MAX(strptime(CAST(date_key AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d')) - INTERVAL 6 DAY, '%Y%m%d') AS INTEGER) FROM fact_sales) GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Net sales of dairy by store in the east
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE p.category = 'Dairy' AND s.region = 'East' GROUP BY 1

subject: finance.partner@fernhill.example
question: Gross margin by category
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(f.cost_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Which category had the highest net sales?
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS v FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Warm hours by store
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, SUM(z.hours_above_threshold) FROM fact_freezer_daily z JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Average freezer temperature by region
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(AVG(z.avg_temp_c), 2) FROM fact_freezer_daily z JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Tickets by ticket category
reference_sql: SELECT t.category, COUNT(*) FROM fact_ticket t GROUP BY 1

subject: west.manager@fernhill.example
question: Tickets by store
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(*) FROM fact_ticket t JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.region = 'West' GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Net sales for gold members by region
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE c.tier = 'gold' GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Units by day of week
reference_sql: SELECT d.day_of_week, SUM(f.qty) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) GROUP BY 1

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Net sales per month
reference_sql: SELECT d.month, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) GROUP BY 1

subject: north.manager@fernhill.example
question: Top 2 stores by transactions in the last 2 weeks
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.txn_id) AS v FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.region = 'North' AND f.date_key >= (SELECT CAST(strftime(MAX(strptime(CAST(date_key AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d')) - INTERVAL 13 DAY, '%Y%m%d') AS INTEGER) FROM fact_sales) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 2

subject: exec.viewer@fernhill.example
question: Units of frozen and bakery by brand
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(f.qty) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE p.category IN ('Frozen', 'Bakery') GROUP BY 1
